title: ACK — Pascal / C / Modula-2 cross-compiled to 8086 DOS

expect: Factorials, compiled by ACK, running on the 8086:

notes: ACK is a BSD-3 cross-compiler that runs on a modern host and EMITS 8086 DOS .COM programs. The three .com files here were compiled by ACK (pinned commit above) from the sources in samples/, and each RUNS on the bw-board 8086 DOS service layer (scripts/run-dos.mjs --preset xt), printing the strings in its expect[]. This is a libre Pascal (and C, Modula-2) whose OUTPUT runs natively on our 8086 — the compiler itself is a host tool, not an 8086 program (contrast Small-C, whose compiler runs on the 8086). Pascal's runtime prints a cosmetic 'file OUTPUT: close error' after its correct output because the DOS service layer does not implement the file-close call ACK's Pascal library makes at exit; C and Modula-2 exit clean.
